name: pi-skill-extension
description: Pi extension for durable TypeScript skill orchestration and composition

scripts.evals:known-delta: set -eu; bundle=$(mktemp /tmp/penny-evaluation-cli.XXXXXX.mjs); trap 'rm -f "$bundle"' EXIT; bun build evaluation-cli.ts --target=node --outfile="$bundle" >/dev/null; node "$bundle" --project-root ../../.. --population evals/fixtures/synthetic-known-delta.population.v1.json --plan evals/fixtures/synthetic-known-delta.plan.v1.json
scripts.evals:remote-calibration: set -eu; bundle=$(mktemp node_modules/.penny-remote-calibration.XXXXXX.mjs); trap 'rm -f "$bundle"' EXIT; bun build evaluation-remote-calibration-cli.ts --target=node --external '@earendil-works/pi-ai' --external '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent' --external '@earendil-works/pi-tui' --outfile="$bundle" >/dev/null; node "$bundle"
scripts.test:benchmark:aggregate: if test "${PENNY_EVALS_LOCAL_TESTS:-}" = "1"; then test -d ../../../evals || { echo 'Local benchmark files are missing from evals/' >&2; exit 1; }; bunx vitest run --config "tests/vitest.benchmark.config.ts"; else echo 'Skipping ignored local benchmark tests; run bun run evals:test to opt in.'; fi
scripts.test:all: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:benchmark:aggregate
